nodes.label: Optimistic Offline Ingredient Validation
nodes.rationale: When mqttRepository.send("validate-ingredient",...) returns MqttResult.Queued (offline), validateIngredient returns an optimistic IngredientValidationResult.Valid built from the scanned tagId rather than failing, so operators are not blocked from scanning ingredients while the device is disconnected; reconciliation happens once the queued message is delivered.

nodes.label: Hopper Barcode Workflow Supersedes Manual Mixer Code Entry
nodes.rationale: Task 5 removed the MIXER_CODE route and deleted MixerCodeScreen, replacing manual mixer-code entry with a HOPPER_SCAN route backed by HopperScanScreen (Task 6), which allocates a hopper via DataWedge barcode scan and shows live hopper availability chips fed by MQTT hopperStatusUpdates, reducing manual entry error and giving real-time hopper contention visibility.
nodes.norm_label: hopper barcode workflow supersedes manual mixer code entry

nodes.label: MixingViewModel Scoped to Mixing Nav Subgraph
nodes.rationale: AppNavGraph was refactored to wrap JobLookup, IngredientScan, HopperScan, and PreMixComplete screens in a nested navigation(route="mixing") subgraph, with each screen resolving MixingViewModel via hiltViewModel(navController.getBackStackEntry("mixing")). This pins one ViewModel instance (scanned ingredients, hopperCode, uiState) across the whole pre-mix flow for a single job instead of a fresh instance per screen, which would have lost state on navigation.
nodes.norm_label: mixingviewmodel scoped to mixing nav subgraph

nodes.label: Supervisor RFID Approval for Ingredient Exceptions
nodes.rationale: Invalid ingredient scans transition MixingViewModel to WaitingForSupervisor rather than requiring a network approval screen; scanning a supervisor's RFID tag calls approveIngredientException, and on success the ingredient is appended with isException=true and approvedBy=supervisorName, keeping the override auditable and usable on the shop floor without extra hardware.
nodes.norm_label: supervisor rfid approval for ingredient exceptions

nodes.label: HomeScreen Revised to Tile Grid with AppScaffold (removes ConnectionStatusBar)
nodes.rationale: A later commit (1732fba), recorded appended to the Task 4 report, rewrote HomeScreen.kt into a 2-large/2-small tile grid (Mixing, Rajoo, RFID Recovery, Dashboard) using AppScaffold for the top bar and connection-state display, and deleted ConnectionStatusBar.kt after verifying no remaining imports referenced it — superseding the original Task 9 ConnectionStatusBar-based HomeScreen layout.
nodes.norm_label: homescreen revised to tile grid with appscaffold (removes connectionstatusbar)

nodes.label: External Repo Read-Only Except RFID_MQTT_CONTRACT.md
nodes.rationale: Restricts writes in the sibling C:\Dev\PPNAM-Station-2 WPF/Core/CLI repo to RFID_MQTT_CONTRACT.md only; every other file/folder there (Android_App, DOCS, Database, PPNAM.Station2.CLI/Core/Tests/WPF, SAP_Sample_Data, references, other .md/.slnx files) is read-only reference material, preventing accidental cross-repo modification while still allowing the MQTT contract to be updated collaboratively.
